text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 2021 G80 2.5T Prestige (about 6,400 miles) praises the very clear backup and surround-view camera. Owner finds the automatic stop-start annoying in Miami heat because it cuts the A/C at lights, and wants a way to disable it permanently. Owner states CarPlay and Bluetooth did not work for the first six months, though it now seems fixed. Owner states the 2.5T engine is plenty for their needs and they love the car overall. Original excerpt(s), from tool summaries: «super crystal clear»

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 2021 G80 2.5T finds the ride smooth and the 2.5T more nimble than the 3.5T, which felt heavier with more body roll in long curves. Owner states the 2.5T has enough power for highway passing, cruises at 85+ mph around 2,000-2,500 rpm, and pairs well with the 8-speed transmission. Owner states the 2.5T's fuel economy is better than the 3.5T's. Owner finds head-up displays distracting and does not want one (also switches off the HUD and stop-start in their father's BMW SUV).

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 2021 G80 2.5T Prestige reports about 30 mpg overall after more than 9,000 miles. Owner states highway and two-lane passing has never been an issue and takeoff is good, though not like a six-cylinder. Owner reports occasional harsh shifts in city driving, as if the transmission skips a gear when getting back on the throttle.
